description: Make the page download a file and keep it. Either click something that produces a download — an “Export CSV” button, a “Download invoice” link — or give a direct url, which is fetched in the browser’s own logged-in session rather than anonymously. The file lands in the user’s ~/browsentic/download/ folder and the result reports the path and notes about what arrived; you get the notes, never the bytes. Hand the returned downloadId to page.attachFile to upload it somewhere else without the file ever passing through you.

target.description: The link or button whose click starts the download. Give this or "url", not both.

nth.description: Zero-based index when several elements match

role.description: Tag name or ARIA role to narrow matches, e.g. "button" or "link"

text.description: Case-insensitive visible text the element should contain

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the download to finish before giving up.

url.description: Direct http(s) url of the file, fetched with the browser’s cookies. Give this or "target", not both. Prefer "target" when a button exists: many exports have no fetchable url at all.

name: page_captureDownload
